uncataloged.reason: Genuine in-range functional bug distinct from GV3-148 (which only flags code-style duplication). install.sh:173-180 (new PEEK_PORT/PEEK_CONTROL_PORT block) does `pid="$(lsof -tiTCP:"$peek_port" -sTCP:LISTEN || true)"`; when lsof returns multiple PID lines, $pid holds an embedded-newline multi-line string. `kill "$pid"` then receives one malformed argument, fails, and is swallowed by the trailing `|| true`; the following `while kill -0 "$pid"` also fails immediately (invalid argument), so the wait loop exits as if the process were already gone -- a silent no-op on the actual stale process. Same latent pattern also exists in the pre-existing ADDR_PORT block, but this candidate's claim is specifically about the newly introduced PEEK_PORT/PEEK_CONTROL_PORT sites added by this diff, and no golden entry catalogs the multi-pid functional defect (GV3-148's claim is duplication/code-style only).
